newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent indicated lower on NYMEX weakness.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent indicated lower on NYMEX weakness.

text.p: Brent crude futures were untraded around midday on Tuesday and indicated lower as NYMEX crude suffered a further bout of profit taking.
July Brent was quoted around midday at $19.67/$19.85 per barrel after London on Friday settled at $20.00.
Brokers said the softer tone was promoted by some scaling down of long positions on NYMEX.
July NYMEX crude fell 23 cents in New York on Friday to $21.63.
The selling continued on the after-hours ACCESS system in Asia on Tuesday. July was last traded at $21.43, down a further 20 cents.
Brokers said support around $21.45 was under pressure and a break below $21.40 would indicate a later test of $21.00.
